description: SafeBite lets authenticated food-business clients consult their own HACCP records through ChatGPT. Users can review daily temperature and cleaning controls, find recent temperature anomalies, search and open operational records, and obtain a read-only inspection-readiness snapshot. The integration cannot create, change, or delete SafeBite data.

defaultPrompt: Mostra os controlos HACCP previstos para hoje.
Mostra as anomalias de temperatura dos últimos 7 dias.
Prepara um resumo da prontidão desta conta para uma inspeção HACCP.
